notes.title: LEFT ALIVE deploys on 5th March 2019. Pre-purchase your DAY ONE EDITION now!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that LEFT ALIVE, the upcoming survival action shooter from veteran developers, Toshifumi Nabeshima (director, Armored Core series), Yoji Shinkawa from KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS (character designer, METAL GEAR series), and Takayuki Yanase (mech designer , Mobile Suit Gundam 00, Xenoblade Chronicles X) will release on 5th March 2019 on STEAM. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30687658/1b9a8cf1ed46429a72cde027b32ac22ab9cfbe89.jpg

LEFT ALIVE tells a story of survival from the perspective of three different protagonists during the devastating invasion set in war-torn Novo Slava in 2127. Experience the massive power gap between man and machine in pulse-pounding encounters: face off against powerfully armed troops, armored vehicles and towering mechs. 

Deploying on launch day and available for a limited time only, the LEFT ALIVE DAY ONE EDITION is now available for pre-purchase; it includes a host of bonus digital content and explosive DLC. The LEFT ALIVE DAY ONE EDITION includes the following content:


Full game

The Destructive DLC Pack:

Ammo Pack
Light Body Armor 
Recovery Pack
Padub Weapon (exclusive)


A digital soundtrack sampler featuring music tracks from the game

A set of x5 stunning wallpapers including designs from legendary Yoji Shinkawa from KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS (Sizes: 1024 x 768, 1280 x 1024, 1920 x 1080, 2560 x 1600)


See you on the battlefield….

 PRE-PURCHASE NOW
